gt_usage_pattern_cn: GT局部裁剪作为形态锚点
allowed_posthoc_use_cn: use GT crop to inspect vehicle-scale SAR morphology after a factor is proposed
forbidden_runtime_use_cn: do not use GT crop to create runtime support window threshold or candidate
required_positive_fit_analysis_cn: explain ridge hotspot weak-side return or shell evidence inside GT-local region
required_negative_contrast_analysis_cn: compare nearby outside-GT background road-edge guardrail or competitor regions
leakage_risk_cn: high if crop statistics become runtime constants

allowed_posthoc_use_cn: use overlap to audit whether runtime-safe support missed or covered the reference
forbidden_runtime_use_cn: do not use overlap to select candidates rank boxes or prove identity
required_positive_fit_analysis_cn: explain what vehicle-scale structure is actually covered by the overlap
required_negative_contrast_analysis_cn: show why overlapped bright points outside vehicle-scale structure are insufficient
leakage_risk_cn: high if overlap becomes score target
correct_treatment_cn: coverage audit only and not mechanism proof
notes: overlap without morphology is not enough

allowed_posthoc_use_cn: use GT quality to weaken or route uncertain morphology conclusions
forbidden_runtime_use_cn: do not revise GT boxes or create corrected annotation boxes
required_positive_fit_analysis_cn: state whether GT scale offset boundary or neighbor mixing affects positive fit
required_negative_contrast_analysis_cn: compare questionable GT to surrounding structures and annotation ambiguity
leakage_risk_cn: medium if quality notes become revised labels
correct_treatment_cn: record quality caveat and defer if unreliable
notes: keeps GT quality and support failure separate

allowed_posthoc_use_cn: use GT-local SAR energy to validate part/shell vocabulary
forbidden_runtime_use_cn: do not define runtime morphology labels or thresholds from GT-local crop
required_positive_fit_analysis_cn: describe vehicle-scale ridge endpoint weak-side shell or drift evidence
required_negative_contrast_analysis_cn: reject isolated peaks texture blobs and background lines that fail the same vocabulary
leakage_risk_cn: high if local labels become runtime priors
notes: SAR image evidence is useful but permission-bound

allowed_posthoc_use_cn: use GT-local vehicle structure to diagnose support miss after support is fixed
forbidden_runtime_use_cn: do not move support to GT or widen shell from GT center
required_positive_fit_analysis_cn: explain why GT-local vehicle body lies outside or partly outside support
required_negative_contrast_analysis_cn: show why support-internal tiny components are not the vehicle
leakage_risk_cn: high if support correction is derived from GT
correct_treatment_cn: mark support construction failure or mapping uncertainty
notes: do not search inside wrong support for baby-car component

allowed_posthoc_use_cn: use GT center only to evaluate an independently defined feasible domain
forbidden_runtime_use_cn: do not use GT center to define azimuth/range factor or sector center
required_positive_fit_analysis_cn: show whether runtime-defined domain contains vehicle-local structure
required_negative_contrast_analysis_cn: check nearby non-target domains and competitors under the same rule
correct_treatment_cn: keep GT center out of construction and thresholds

allowed_posthoc_use_cn: use GT-local intensity only to describe posthoc morphology quality
forbidden_runtime_use_cn: do not set runtime intensity contrast threshold from GT crop
required_positive_fit_analysis_cn: explain why GT-local intensity pattern is physically meaningful
required_negative_contrast_analysis_cn: show why background bright spots or static reflectors fail scale and composition
correct_treatment_cn: defer threshold design until runtime-safe calibration exists

allowed_posthoc_use_cn: identify missing negative contrast as insufficient validation
forbidden_runtime_use_cn: do not admit a factor from GT-positive example alone
required_positive_fit_analysis_cn: state positive fit if present but mark it incomplete
required_negative_contrast_analysis_cn: require nearby outside-GT background road-edge guardrail competitor checks
correct_treatment_cn: defer promotion until negative contrast exists
notes: positive GT-local fit is necessary but not sufficient

allowed_posthoc_use_cn: use failure inside GT to classify weak SAR signal GT quality truncation support miss clutter or mapping uncertainty
forbidden_runtime_use_cn: do not tune around failure using GT-specific fix
required_positive_fit_analysis_cn: explain why expected mechanism fails or weakens inside GT
required_negative_contrast_analysis_cn: compare whether similar failure appears in non-target regions
correct_treatment_cn: record failure mode and defer or reject factor
notes: failure cases are evidence not embarrassment

allowed_posthoc_use_cn: use nearby competitor GT or visible competitor context to test ambiguity
forbidden_runtime_use_cn: do not select target identity from GT overlap
required_positive_fit_analysis_cn: explain target-local fit separately from competitor-local fit
required_negative_contrast_analysis_cn: show whether competitor satisfies same mechanism and why boundary stays blocked
correct_treatment_cn: preserve boundary or competition until independent evidence resolves it

allowed_posthoc_use_cn: use SAR-only GT rows as SAR morphology reference only
forbidden_runtime_use_cn: do not mix SAR-only rows into optical-to-SAR correspondence statistics
required_positive_fit_analysis_cn: explain SAR vehicle-scale structure within SAR-only reference
required_negative_contrast_analysis_cn: compare SAR-only vehicle structure with non-vehicle background examples
notes: SAR-only is not paired optical evidence

allowed_posthoc_use_cn: use manual or review anchors to explain uncertainty or route review
forbidden_runtime_use_cn: do not write manual labels into runtime construction or revised GT
required_positive_fit_analysis_cn: state how manual observation supports or weakens posthoc interpretation
required_negative_contrast_analysis_cn: compare against cases without manual support and note uncertainty
correct_treatment_cn: manual/review anchor remains posthoc or review-only
